cohort: 5 pregnant women with advanced chronic kidney disease (1 with Stage 5 CKD and 4 on maintenance hemodialysis)
finding: Dialysis-related care and general clinical management improved the clinical outcome of pregnancy for patients with advanced CKD, with no maternal or neonatal deaths observed.
mod_finding: 3 out of 5 women in the study underwent emergency cesarean sections due to pre-eclampsia.
